lines.text: A typesetting system takes a description of a document and decides where
every character goes. It breaks paragraphs into lines and stacks the lines into
pages.1
Lines of a paragraph are chosen together rather than one at a time, so that
the spacing is as even as the words allow and few hyphens appear.2
